claim: Vision-LLMs in zero-shot anomaly detection perform better on simple spatially salient events and worse on noisy spatial cues and identity obfuscation.
falsifier: On a held-out set of anomaly detection videos categorized by event type, compare accuracy across categories using the same vision-LLM and NLI classifier.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported models, tasks, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Event type–Anomaly detection accuracy principle
